rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans. Use Tajawal/Quicksand for a soft, friendly, and trustworthy feel.

Always set dir='rtl' on the root or main Arabic containers. Use logical Tailwind properties (ps-*, pe-*, ms-*, me-*, text-start, text-end) instead of left/right specific properties so it gracefully supports both Arabic (RTL) and French/English (LTR).
Archetype: Organic & Earthy + Pastel & Soft. Represents warmth, trust, and storytelling magic.
Background should be warm bone-white/cream, never pure white.
Text should be deep Navy (#3D405B) or Charcoal (#2B2D42) for high APCA contrast. NEVER pure black.
Avoid harsh full-screen gradients. Use soft radial glows of accent_yellow or accent_green behind floating elements.

surface_styles.wizard_steps: Neumorphic tactile buttons for selecting options (boy/girl, story type). Soft shadows with crisp 1px inner borders.
surface_styles.header: Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-b border-border/40.

rules: Use 'Lenis' for smooth scrolling on the marketing page.
Wizard steps should transition with a horizontal slide or 'page turn' effect (using Framer Motion).
Hover states on cards: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and increased shadow.
All buttons must have a scale down on tap (active:scale-95).

layouts_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding: p-6, p-8 for cards, p-16 to p-32 for section gaps. Children's themes need breathing room.

grids.marketing_hero: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Text content spans 7 cols, Image spans 5 cols.
grids.bento_features: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 gap-6. Mix square and wide rectangles for 'How it works'.

layouts_and_spacing.alignment: RTL-first. Hero content should start on the right for Arabic. Ensure all flex containers use flex-row (which naturally flips in RTL) and logical spacing (gap-x-4).

specific_components.Wizard: Multi-step form using state. Progress bar at the top using accent_green.
specific_components.PhotoUpload: Drag-and-drop zone with dashed border, rounded-2xl, soft background.
specific_components.OrderTracker: Vertical timeline with icons (Phosphor icons). Completed steps in accent_green, current in primary.
specific_components.Pricing: Highlight the 3400 DZD price clearly with a 'Best Value' or 'Magical Gift' badge.

media.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for a magical, illustrated feel).

images.description: Girl reading a book with warm light, conveying the joy of storytelling.
Parents and child reading together, building trust and family bonding.
A book glowing with green magical light, representing the AI personalization.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Terracotta primary button meets minimum 3:1 APCA. Use deep Navy for all text on light backgrounds.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical layouts to create tension and interest.

CRITICAL for RTL: Use Tailwind's logical properties. Replace 'pl-*' with 'ps-*', 'pr-*' with 'pe-*', 'ml-*' with 'ms-*', 'mr-*' with 'me-*', 'text-left' with 'text-start', 'text-right' with 'text-end', 'border-l' with 'border-s', 'border-r' with 'border-e'.
Ensure 'dir="rtl"' is dynamically handled or set on the root for Arabic.
Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone) to match the children's storybook aesthetic.
Every interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='start-wizard-btn').
DO NOT use a completely transparent background on the sticky header. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70.
instructions_to_main_agent: Start by installing dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, lenis (for smooth scroll), lucide-react (if shadcn uses it natively, but prefer phosphor where possible).
Set up Tajawal, Quicksand, and Amiri fonts in index.css using Google Fonts @import.
Build the hybrid app: A marketing landing page with a hero, 'How it works' bento grid, pricing (3400 DZD), and a prominent CTA 'إصنع قصة طفلك الآن' (Create your child's story now).
Implement the Multi-step Wizard: 1. Child Details (Name, Age, Gender), 2. Story Goal, 3. Photo Upload (with privacy consent checkbox), 4. Language Selection (AR/EN/FR).
Implement the Order Tracking UI (Timeline) and a mock Admin Dashboard table for managing orders.
Ensure the entire app is fully responsive, looking great on mobile since parents will likely order via phones.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the marketing layouts, and customized Shadcn components for Wizard forms and Admin UI.
